historical_evidence.finding: Superstar suppression profiles with a Q5c sequential-triggering analysis; verdict 'rank-1 suppressor varies meaningfully across players'. Rank-1 deltas were mostly within 1-2 SE with no multiple-comparison control; an OTHER artifact was flagged. Failure mechanism recorded as E_unclear. Validation not recorded.

Observed on-ball defensive scheme labels (DROP/ICE/SWITCH) from NBA matchup and PBP fields. Confident labels covered 14.9% of DET possessions (10/67) and 3.3% of ORL possessions (2/60); switches_on was not populated. Verdict recorded as failed_gate.

PBP-derived shot-level PNR shares for 2024-25 ranged from OKC 7.567% and BOS 7.854% to IND 13.824% and NYK 11.959%. Rates serve as a calibration input; later logs show calibrated PNR at about 17.9-19.6% of possessions. Verdict descriptive.

Calibrated simulation versus Elo and lineup baselines. Validation win accuracy 68.9% fell on holdout to 54.8%, against 58.1% for Elo and 64.5% for lineup +/-. Failure mechanism recorded as C_artifact (apparent effect produced by a construction, selection or labelling flaw).

A1 adaptation falsification tests on asymmetry, confidence and carryover. Recorded failure mechanism C_artifact; the next-game carryover test gave Welch p=0.842, and limitations include selection and regression to the mean.

Linear team+opponent+play_type baseline versus a simulation kernel. Linear margin R=+0.505; kernel R=+0.466 versus linear additive R=+0.467. Failure mechanism B_powered_null; sample and power recorded as NOT_RECORDED for CHT-004.

Star initiator suppression by lineup and forced play type. Giannis forced PULL_UP PPP 0.848 (-0.540) against preferred DRIVE. No placebo or matching was used, and later sequence work treated similar star-chain gaps as artifacts. Verdict E_unclear.

Whether the PNR and PULL_UP tags are stable across 2022-23 through 2025-26. SF-APPS-012 notes a possible tagging shift but does not resolve it.
Anything about the 2025-26 playoffs, which were partial as of the analysis date.
own_inferences: The question is a conditional claim with two undefined terms (PNR fail and unit), so it cannot be tested as written. The threshold rule would be decided by unit definition alone, not by the data.

historical_effect.explanation: The retrieved records show that similar play-type and counter claims in this project repeatedly ended as artifacts, untestable, or inconclusive because of labelling error, selection, missing placebos and missing multiplicity control. risks.text: If PNR fail is defined using the possession outcome, the lift test is circular. Any PNR-fail flag must be set before the PULL_UP shot.
Play-type and coverage labels from the PBP have low confident-label rates (SF-APPS-058: 14.9% and 3.3%) and a possible tagging shift (SF-APPS-012).
PNR-derived share is a calibrated input rather than an audited measurement (SF-APPM-058), so the PNR-fail and PULL_UP labels may be unreliable.
A 2pp median lift requires substantial PULL_UP-after-PNR-fail exposure per unit. Team-level cells may not reach that, so the test may be underpowered.
Unit-level counts may be below the 30-possession minimum used in earlier descriptive work (SF-APPS-012), leaving many units undefined or noisy.
Shot distance, shot quality, defender matchup, opponent and game state are not controlled, so a positive lift may reflect shot selection.
Teams that allow PNR fails may be systematically different, and a positive lift may reflect regression to the mean rather than a counter (similar selection issues in SF-APPA-001 and SF13).
Testing PULL_UP and other play types across many units without correction inflates false positives (SF-APPM-022).
Without placebo play types or placebo seasons, positive lift is not distinguishable from a general efficiency pattern (SF-CHT-009).
The 70% positive-unit rule can be met by a small positive bias in PULL_UP efficiency relative to alternatives, regardless of whether a real counter exists.
Four seasons (2022-23 to 2025-26) and regular-season versus playoff contexts may differ in defense and shot mix (SF-APPS-012), so pooling may mask or manufacture the effect.
The 2pp median threshold may sit near the noise floor for PPP differences at the unit sizes available, so a threshold rule can be triggered by sampling variation alone.

design.estimand: Within each defensive unit, the difference in points per possession (PPP) between PULL_UP and a pre-specified alternative play type, conditional on a pre-outcome PNR-fail indicator (defined before the shot and independent of its points or turnover), adjusted for shot distance, defender matchup, opponent and game state.
design.unit: Defensive team-season (30 teams x 4 seasons) as the primary unit, with defensive team x opponent as a sensitivity unit. Units below the pre-specified minimum PNR-fail-to-PULL_UP sequence count are excluded and reported.
design.sample: Regular season 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 (complete) and 2025-26 regular season (complete from 2026-04-13). Exclude 2025-26 playoffs, which were partial as of 2026-05-23.
design.power: Not yet computed. Must be established before analysis from the per-unit exposure counts; a unit is included only if its exposure supports an interval narrower than the 2pp threshold.
design.controls: Shot distance, defender matchup, opponent, lineup and game state, applied by matching or regression. The PNR-fail flag is set before the shot.
design.falsification: Placebo play types (for example a non-counter play type after PNR fail) and placebo seasons should show lift near zero; a positive placebo lift would indicate confounding.
design.multiplicity: Holm correction across units, with the 70%-positive share and the median-lift rule evaluated against a placebo-derived null distribution.
design.decision_rule: Supported only if the pre-specified unit-level lift is positive in at least 70% of included units, the median lift exceeds 2pp with a confidence interval that excludes 2pp below, and the placebo lift is near zero. Otherwise report as rejected, artifact or uncertain according to the failure pattern.
design.data_version: Regular season 2022-23 through 2024-25 (complete) and 2025-26 regular season complete from 2026-04-13. 2025-26 playoffs excluded because they were partial as of 2026-05-23.

You are a basketball analytics researcher deciding whether and how a research question should be studied.
You work only from the task statement and the tools listed below. Do not assume facts you have not seen.

The work has two stages, in this order.

1. Read the research objective and the data description.
2. Identify the research concepts and methodological questions the task raises.
3. Retrieve historical evidence by calling retrieve_history.
In stage 1 do not assess the question, predict outcomes or decide. Your only stage-1 reply is the retrieve_history call.
Stage 2, assessment, after the retrieval result is returned:
4. Summarise the relevant historical findings and failed approaches.
5. State what the historical evidence does and does not establish.
6. Assess whether the research question is testable.
7. Identify methodological risks and potential confounders.
8. Make the final research decision.
9. Explain whether and how the historical evidence changed the decision.
